key_decisions: SHIP THE DISTILLED CHECKPOINT, DROP TURBO. UNETLoader now on flux-2-klein-4b-int8-convrot.safetensors (4074445184 B, sha256 ac629fa69e0700ae689bce6b694ac0fc90ba5c24de15bd6c47195ad0c16fe90e, source HF wraps/FLUX.2-klein-4B-INT8-ConvRot-ComfyUI). Verified genuine distilled: header metadata shows it was quantized from flux-2-klein-4b.safetensors via OTUNetLoaderW8A8 outlier_method=convrot, dtype split 80 I8 / 80 U8 / 80 F32 / 69 BF16 = the documented distilled 80/69 split (base is 70/79). Turbo LoRA node is bypassed at strength 0, kept in the graph so the two-tier wiring survives for a future Klein 9B.

CONSEQUENCE FOR THE MODELDEF: negativePrompt should be FALSE. Per README, the negative is bit-identical at cfg 1.0 (max diff 0) and only live at cfg 5.0 on base. Distilled-only runs at cfg 1.0, so the negative field must not render. turboToggle also FALSE unless the boolean is kept purely to gate cfg/steps.

ONE MASTER TEMPLATE FOR ALL IMAGE MODELS. Single file, all ops in it, output chosen by MpiAnySwitch10 driven by Input_wf_type (1=t2i, 2=i2i, 3=depth, 4=edit, 5=inpaint, 6=detail, 7=upscale). NO PRUNING CONVERTER NEEDED - lazy evaluation confirmed empirically: t2i run 4.03s vs depth run 7.46s on a 196-node graph containing four samplers. Only the selected branch executes.

Input_wf_type is JUST ANOTHER INJECTED CONTROL (an MpiInt with a title), not converter machinery - it rides the same injection path as Input_Seed / Input_Width. It also drives internal gates (is_i2i = wf_type==2, is_remove via MpiBooleanCompare), so it must be set per op.

IF a pruner is ever built, do NOT use a reroute naming convention. Use reachability: keep = transitive_closure(switch.inputs[wf_type]) UNION transitive_closure(output_node); drop the rest. Shared infrastructure falls out correctly for free. A naming rule is a human discipline that rots; reachability is derived. Build it on the SECOND model that uses the template, not the first.
Step counts REVISED by live measurement: t2i = 4 steps (8 overcooks), detail = 2, upscale = 2, inpaint = 2 (inpaint phase) + 2 (detail phase). Roughly half-steps for the second-pass ops.

Removal ships as TWO STAGES (removal + detail), baked in, no user toggle. Detail area capped at 1024x1024; ~7s typical, ~23s worst. The detail stage overwrites the prompt with an empty text encode - it details what it sees rather than adding what the prompt says.
ReplaceSubject LoRA is OUT of the model scope - user's call: too specific for a model op, it is an App candidate.
constraints: GRAYSCALE ROOT CAUSE (cost most of a day, do not re-derive). Depth refcontrol output came out flat grey/desaturated. It is NOT a graph bug. The depth map is a GRAYSCALE image fed in as a ReferenceLatent, and at cfg 1.0 there is no classifier-free guidance to amplify the text - so a short prompt loses to the reference and the output inherits the reference's greyness. Confirmed by extreme prompt sensitivity (adding or removing one space flipped good/bad). FIX SHIPPED: StringConcatenate#133 string_a is now 'refcontrol, color'. The prefix is a BIAS, NOT A CLAMP - 'a black and white photo of...' still correctly yields B&W.

SIDE EFFECT OF THE COLOR PREFIX, A/B'd same-seed and ACCEPTED BY USER: klein-style-vintage goes from full sepia monochrome to muted colour under a depth ref. Composition identical, palette only. User's position: the user can always prompt for black and white.

STYLE x DEPTH IS PARTLY MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE. Palette/texture styles (Vintage, Aesthetic) survive a depth reference because they only repaint. Subject-transforming styles (Muppets, Chibi, Doodle, Jojo) CANNOT work under depth control - depth clamps the geometry to the source silhouette, so 'a woman walking a dog' + Muppets yields a human woman walking a Muppet. It only works if the transformation is in the NOUN ('a Muppet woman walking a Muppet dog'). Relevant to styleLoraLabels shipping beside a depth op.

WIDGET-VS-LINK TRAP (burned an afternoon). Flux2Scheduler.steps and CFGGuider.cfg have INPUT LINKS in this template, so their on-node widget values are DEAD and editing them does nothing. Real values live in MpiMath#203 (steps = '4 if a else 20') and MpiMath#204 (cfg = '1.0 if a else 5.0'), both fed by MpiSimpleBoolean#52 Input_is_Turbo. Check for a connected input before trusting any widget number in this graph.

ONE-FILE TEMPLATE FOOTGUN: an op that forgets to set Input_wf_type fails SILENTLY - it runs whatever branch the default selects and returns a plausible wrong image that looks like a model quality problem. Build the assert.

ComfyUI validates EVERY node's inputs at submit time even when a branch is lazily skipped. The template survives this because image loads use MpiLoadImageFromPath with block_if_empty:false (returns a blank instead of erroring). Keep that discipline on every new branch or the one-file template breaks.
